package student

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
	domainservice "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/service"
	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

var (
	defaultStaticPreviewComposeConfig = json.RawMessage(`{
  "version": "3.9",
  "services": {
    "web": {
      "image": "nginx:stable-alpine"
    }
  }
}`)
	defaultWorkspaceComposeConfig = json.RawMessage(`{
  "version": "3.9",
  "services": {
    "app": {
      "image": "node:20-alpine",
      "working_dir": "/workspace",
      "command": [
        "sh",
        "-c",
        "while true; do sleep 3600; done"
      ]
    }
  }
}`)
)

type StudentUseCase struct {
	Catalog          PracticeTaskCatalog
	Students         repository.StudentPracticeTaskRepository
	Answers          repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	Builders         BuildUseCase
	Completion       domain.CourseCompletionClient
	CourseContent    CourseContentProvider
	Sandbox          domain.SandboxRuntimeClient
	Validation       domain.ValidationRuntimeClient
	AIReview         PracticeTaskAIReviewClient
	Publications     domain.PracticeTaskPublicationRepository
	PublicationFiles domain.PracticeTaskPublicationFileStorage
	AnswerStarter    RuntimeAnswerStarter
	FinalValidator   RuntimeAnswerFinalValidator
}

type CourseContentProvider interface {
	GetLesson(ctx context.Context, lessonID string) (*answeruc.LessonMetadata, error)
	GetCourseStructure(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (*answeruc.CourseStructure, error)
}

type RuntimeAnswerStarter interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, in answeruc.StartTaskAnswerInput) (answeruc.StartTaskAnswerOutput, error)
}

type RuntimeAnswerFinalValidator interface {
	Handle(ctx context.Context, answerID string, answerPayload json.RawMessage) error
}

type currentMilestoneContext struct {
	studentPracticeTask          *domain.StudentPracticeTask
	project                      *domain.PracticeTask
	practiceTaskMilestones       []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone
	studentMilestones            []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone
	currentPracticeTaskMilestone *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone
	currentStudentMilestone      *domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone
	part                         *domain.PracticeTaskPart
	preview                      *MilestoneBuildPreview
}

type milestoneRuntimePlan struct {
	TaskID                string
	CodeStructureTypeCode string
	ComposeConfig         json.RawMessage
	ContractJSON          json.RawMessage
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) CreateStudentPracticeTask(ctx context.Context, studentID, practiceTaskID, solutionVariantID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTask, error) {
	runtimeContext, err := useCase.Catalog.GetPublishedRuntimeContext(ctx, practiceTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if strings.TrimSpace(runtimeContext.RevisionID) == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: practice task has no published revision", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	variant, err := selectPracticeTaskSolutionVariant(runtimeContext.SolutionVariants, solutionVariantID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	milestones, err := milestonesForSolutionVariant(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, variant)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	now := time.Now().UTC()
	startedAt := now
	studentPracticeTask := domain.StudentPracticeTask{
		ID:                            uuid.NewString(),
		StudentID:                     studentID,
		PracticeTaskID:                practiceTaskID,
		PracticeTaskRevisionID:        runtimeContext.RevisionID,
		PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID: variant.ID,
		Status:                        domain.StudentPracticeTaskStatusActive,
		StartedAt:                     &startedAt,
		CreatedAt:                     now,
		UpdatedAt:                     now,
		WorkspaceTaskID:               uuid.NewString(),
		WorkspaceLessonID:             uuid.NewString(),
		WorkspaceStateJSON:            []byte(`{}`),
	}
	studentMilestones := make([]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone, 0, len(milestones))
	for _, milestone := range domainservice.SortMilestonesForStudent(milestones) {
		if !milestone.IsActive {
			continue
		}
		if strings.TrimSpace(milestone.ID) == "" ||
			strings.TrimSpace(milestone.PracticeTaskPartID) == "" ||
			strings.TrimSpace(milestone.PracticeTaskMilestoneID) == "" {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: active milestone is missing catalog identity", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		studentMilestones = append(studentMilestones, domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone{
			ID:                          uuid.NewString(),
			StudentPracticeTaskID:       studentPracticeTask.ID,
			PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID: milestone.ID,
			PracticeTaskPartID:          milestone.PracticeTaskPartID,
			PracticeTaskMilestoneID:     milestone.PracticeTaskMilestoneID,
			Status:                      domain.StudentMilestoneStatusNotStarted,
			AttemptsCount:               0,
			BestResultJSON:              []byte(`{}`),
			CreatedAt:                   now,
			UpdatedAt:                   now,
		})
	}
	if len(studentMilestones) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: practice task has no active milestones", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if err := useCase.Students.CreateStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentPracticeTask, studentMilestones); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentPracticeTask.ID)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) ListStudentPracticeTasks(ctx context.Context, studentID string) ([]domain.StudentPracticeTask, error) {
	return useCase.Students.ListStudentPracticeTasks(ctx, studentID)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID string) (*domain.StudentPracticeTask, error) {
	project, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if project.StudentID != studentID {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return project, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) GetRoadmap(ctx context.Context, studentPracticeTaskID string) (*domain.Roadmap, error) {
	studentPracticeTask, err := useCase.Students.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	runtimeContext, err := useCase.getStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeContext(ctx, studentPracticeTask)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	studentMilestones, err := useCase.Students.ListStudentPracticeTaskMilestones(ctx, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	completedLessonIDs := map[string]struct{}{}
	if useCase.Completion != nil {
		lessonIDs := runtimeContextLessonIDs(runtimeContext)
		completedLessonIDs, err = useCase.Completion.GetCompletedLessonIDs(ctx, studentPracticeTask.StudentID, lessonIDs)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	roadmap := domainservice.CalculateRoadmap(domainservice.RoadmapCalculationInput{
		PracticeTask:           runtimeContext.PracticeTask,
		PracticeTaskMilestones: runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones,
		MilestoneSkillTags:     runtimeContext.MilestoneSkillTags,
		LessonSkillTags:        runtimeContext.LessonSkillTags,
		TaskSkillTags:          runtimeContext.TaskSkillTags,
		StudentPracticeTask:    studentPracticeTask,
		StudentMilestones:      studentMilestones,
		CompletedLessonIDs:     completedLessonIDs,
	})
	statuses, currentMilestoneID, err := useCase.resolveRoadmapStatuses(ctx, studentPracticeTask, runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, studentMilestones, runtimeContext.MilestoneSkillTags, runtimeContext.LessonSkillTags)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if currentMilestoneID != "" {
		roadmap.CurrentMilestoneID = &currentMilestoneID
	}
	for index := range roadmap.Milestones {
		if status, ok := statuses[roadmap.Milestones[index].ID]; ok {
			roadmap.Milestones[index].Status = status
		}
	}
	return &roadmap, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) GetRoadmapForUser(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID string) (*domain.Roadmap, error) {
	project, err := useCase.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return useCase.GetRoadmap(ctx, project.ID)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) Recalculate(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID string) (*domain.Roadmap, error) {
	if _, err := useCase.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return useCase.GetRoadmap(ctx, studentPracticeTaskID)
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) loadCurrentMilestoneContext(ctx context.Context, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID string) (*currentMilestoneContext, error) {
	studentPracticeTask, err := useCase.GetStudentPracticeTask(ctx, studentID, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	runtimeContext, err := useCase.getStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeContext(ctx, studentPracticeTask)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	project := runtimeContext.PracticeTask
	practiceTaskMilestones := runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones
	studentMilestones, err := useCase.Students.ListStudentPracticeTaskMilestones(ctx, studentPracticeTaskID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	studentMilestonesByPracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID := make(map[string]domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone, len(studentMilestones))
	for _, item := range studentMilestones {
		studentMilestonesByPracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID[item.PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID] = item
	}

	var currentPracticeTaskMilestone *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone
	var currentStudentMilestone *domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone
	for _, practiceTaskMilestone := range domainservice.SortMilestonesForStudent(practiceTaskMilestones) {
		studentMilestone, ok := studentMilestonesByPracticeTaskRuntimeMilestoneID[practiceTaskMilestone.ID]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		if studentMilestone.Status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed || studentMilestone.Status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusSkipped {
			continue
		}
		practiceTaskMilestoneCopy := practiceTaskMilestone
		studentMilestoneCopy := studentMilestone
		currentPracticeTaskMilestone = &practiceTaskMilestoneCopy
		currentStudentMilestone = &studentMilestoneCopy
		break
	}
	if currentPracticeTaskMilestone == nil || currentStudentMilestone == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	var part *domain.PracticeTaskPart
	for index := range runtimeContext.PracticeTaskParts {
		if runtimeContext.PracticeTaskParts[index].ID == currentPracticeTaskMilestone.PracticeTaskPartID {
			item := runtimeContext.PracticeTaskParts[index]
			part = &item
			break
		}
	}
	preview, err := useCase.Builders.BuildMilestonePreview(ctx, project, *currentPracticeTaskMilestone, part)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &currentMilestoneContext{
		studentPracticeTask:          studentPracticeTask,
		project:                      &project,
		practiceTaskMilestones:       practiceTaskMilestones,
		studentMilestones:            studentMilestones,
		currentPracticeTaskMilestone: currentPracticeTaskMilestone,
		currentStudentMilestone:      currentStudentMilestone,
		part:                         part,
		preview:                      preview,
	}, nil
}

func (useCase StudentUseCase) getStudentPracticeTaskRuntimeContext(ctx context.Context, studentPracticeTask *domain.StudentPracticeTask) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	if studentPracticeTask == nil {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if revisionID := strings.TrimSpace(studentPracticeTask.PracticeTaskRevisionID); revisionID != "" {
		runtimeContext, err := useCase.Catalog.GetRevisionRuntimeContext(ctx, revisionID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return filterRuntimeContextForStudentVariant(runtimeContext, studentPracticeTask.PracticeTaskSolutionVariantID)
	}
	return useCase.Catalog.GetRuntimeContext(ctx, studentPracticeTask.PracticeTaskID)
}

func selectPracticeTaskSolutionVariant(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant, requestedID string) (domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant, error) {
	requestedID = strings.TrimSpace(requestedID)
	active := make([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.IsActive {
			active = append(active, item)
		}
	}
	if requestedID != "" {
		for _, item := range active {
			if item.ID == requestedID {
				return item, nil
			}
		}
		return domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: solution variant is not available in this revision", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	if len(active) == 1 {
		return active[0], nil
	}
	if len(active) == 0 {
		return domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: practice task has no active solution variants", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: practice_task_solution_variant_id is required", domain.ErrValidation)
}

func milestonesForSolutionVariant(items []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, variant domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant) ([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, error) {
	byID := make(map[string]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		byID[item.ID] = item
	}
	if len(variant.MilestoneBindings) > 0 {
		result := make([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, 0, len(variant.MilestoneBindings))
		seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(variant.MilestoneBindings))
		for _, binding := range variant.MilestoneBindings {
			milestoneID := binding.PracticeTaskPartMilestoneID
			if _, duplicate := seen[milestoneID]; duplicate {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: solution variant contains duplicate milestone %s", domain.ErrValidation, milestoneID)
			}
			seen[milestoneID] = struct{}{}
			milestone, ok := byID[milestoneID]
			if !ok || !milestone.IsActive {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: solution variant references unavailable milestone %s", domain.ErrValidation, milestoneID)
			}
			milestone.PartSortOrder = 0
			milestone.SortOrder = binding.SortOrder
			milestone.IsRequired = binding.IsRequired
			milestone.LessonBindings = append([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeLessonBinding(nil), binding.LessonBindings...)
			result = append(result, milestone)
		}
		if len(result) == 0 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: solution variant has no active milestones", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		return result, nil
	}

	result := make([]domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone, 0, len(variant.MilestoneIDs))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(variant.MilestoneIDs))
	for _, milestoneID := range variant.MilestoneIDs {
		if _, duplicate := seen[milestoneID]; duplicate {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: solution variant contains duplicate milestone %s", domain.ErrValidation, milestoneID)
		}
		seen[milestoneID] = struct{}{}
		milestone, ok := byID[milestoneID]
		if !ok || !milestone.IsActive {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: solution variant references unavailable milestone %s", domain.ErrValidation, milestoneID)
		}
		result = append(result, milestone)
	}
	if len(result) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: solution variant has no active milestones", domain.ErrValidation)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func filterRuntimeContextForStudentVariant(runtimeContext *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, variantID string) (*domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext, error) {
	variantID = strings.TrimSpace(variantID)
	if variantID == "" {
		return runtimeContext, nil
	}
	variant, err := selectPracticeTaskSolutionVariant(runtimeContext.SolutionVariants, variantID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	milestones, err := milestonesForSolutionVariant(runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones, variant)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	copy := *runtimeContext
	copy.PracticeTaskMilestones = milestones
	copy.SolutionVariants = []domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeVariant{variant}
	copy.PracticeTask.Stacks = practiceTaskStacksForVariant(copy.PracticeTask.Stacks, variant.StackCodes)
	return &copy, nil
}

func practiceTaskStacksForVariant(items []domain.PracticeTaskStack, stackCodes []string) []domain.PracticeTaskStack {
	allowed := make(map[string]struct{}, len(stackCodes))
	for _, code := range stackCodes {
		allowed[code] = struct{}{}
	}
	result := make([]domain.PracticeTaskStack, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		if _, ok := allowed[item.StackCode]; ok {
			result = append(result, item)
		}
	}
	return result
}

func buildMilestoneRuntimePlan(current currentMilestoneContext) (milestoneRuntimePlan, error) {
	contractJSON, err := json.Marshal(current.preview.Contract)
	if err != nil {
		return milestoneRuntimePlan{}, err
	}
	codeStructureTypeCode, composeConfig, err := milestoneRuntimeProfile(current.preview.Milestone)
	if err != nil {
		return milestoneRuntimePlan{}, err
	}
	return milestoneRuntimePlan{
		TaskID:                milestoneRuntimeTaskID(current.currentStudentMilestone.ID),
		CodeStructureTypeCode: codeStructureTypeCode,
		ComposeConfig:         composeConfig,
		ContractJSON:          contractJSON,
	}, nil
}

func milestoneRuntimeTaskID(studentMilestoneID string) string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("practice-task-milestone:%s", studentMilestoneID)
}

func milestoneRuntimeProfile(milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) (string, json.RawMessage, error) {
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(milestone.RuntimeProfileJSON)
	if len(trimmed) != 0 && !bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("null")) && !bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("{}")) {
		var profile struct {
			CodeStructureTypeCode string          `json:"code_structure_type_code"`
			ComposeConfig         json.RawMessage `json:"compose_config"`
		}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(trimmed, &profile); err != nil {
			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: invalid stored runtime profile: %v", domain.ErrValidation, err)
		}
		profile.CodeStructureTypeCode = strings.TrimSpace(profile.CodeStructureTypeCode)
		if profile.CodeStructureTypeCode == "" || !validJSONObject(profile.ComposeConfig) {
			return "", nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: stored runtime profile requires code structure and compose config", domain.ErrValidation)
		}
		return profile.CodeStructureTypeCode, profile.ComposeConfig, nil
	}
	return legacyMilestoneCodeStructureTypeCode(milestone), legacyMilestoneComposeConfig(milestone), nil
}

func validJSONObject(raw json.RawMessage) bool {
	var payload map[string]any
	return len(bytes.TrimSpace(raw)) != 0 && json.Unmarshal(raw, &payload) == nil && payload != nil
}

func legacyMilestoneCodeStructureTypeCode(milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) string {
	switch milestone.MilestoneKindCode {
	case "css_catalog_grid":
		return "CSS_BASIC_STYLESHEET"
	default:
		return "HTML_BASIC_DOCUMENT"
	}
}

func legacyMilestoneComposeConfig(milestone domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone) json.RawMessage {
	switch milestone.MilestoneKindCode {
	case "html_page_shell", "html_form_basic", "css_catalog_grid", "js_cart_basic":
		return defaultStaticPreviewComposeConfig
	default:
		return defaultWorkspaceComposeConfig
	}
}

func allMilestonesCompleted(items []domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone) bool {
	for _, item := range items {
		if item.Status != domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed && item.Status != domain.StudentMilestoneStatusSkipped {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validationResultFromMilestone(
	milestone domain.StudentPracticeTaskMilestone,
) (domain.ValidationRunResult, error) {
	trimmed := bytes.TrimSpace(milestone.BestResultJSON)
	if len(trimmed) == 0 || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("null")) || bytes.Equal(trimmed, []byte("{}")) {
		return domain.ValidationRunResult{
			Passed: milestone.Status == domain.StudentMilestoneStatusPassed,
		}, nil
	}

	var result domain.ValidationRunResult
	if err := json.Unmarshal(trimmed, &result); err != nil {
		return domain.ValidationRunResult{}, err
	}
	return result, nil
}

func uniqueLessonIDs(items []domain.LessonSkillTag) []string {
	set := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, item := range items {
		set[item.LessonID] = struct{}{}
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(set))
	for lessonID := range set {
		result = append(result, lessonID)
	}
	return result
}

func runtimeContextLessonIDs(runtimeContext *domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeContext) []string {
	if runtimeContext == nil {
		return nil
	}
	set := make(map[string]struct{})
	for _, lessonID := range uniqueLessonIDs(runtimeContext.LessonSkillTags) {
		set[lessonID] = struct{}{}
	}
	for _, milestone := range runtimeContext.PracticeTaskMilestones {
		for _, binding := range milestone.LessonBindings {
			if lessonID := strings.TrimSpace(binding.LessonID); lessonID != "" {
				set[lessonID] = struct{}{}
			}
		}
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(set))
	for lessonID := range set {
		result = append(result, lessonID)
	}
	sort.Strings(result)
	return result
}
